title: Volcanoes of Vanuatu
intro: 10 volcanoes of Vanuatu, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: East Epi
rounds.fact: East Epi is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2023. The data places it in Vanuatu.
